title: Ikirego cyumvwa hejuru y'urusaku
intro: Urumva ijwi riturutse mu muryango aho gukandamizwa byabaye akamenyero. Nta kugaragaza imbaraga bisubiza ikibazo; ahubwo, ubusabe butaziguye bugera kuri Allah, kandi igisubizo kiba ku mutima w'ugusenga ubwako. Ni nde watanze icyo kirego, ni ikihe kibazo cyakurikiyeho, kandi ni ukuhe kuri kwemejwe?
clues: Navuze icyo kibazo kuri Allah mu kirego cyanjye bwite.
Allah yumvise ikirego maze asubiza anyomoza ku byerekeye ukwemera kwanjye.
Igisubizo cyabajije ukuntu nananiwe kwizera Allah, we Muremure kandi Usumba byose.
Hanyuma nabajije impamvu Allah yagakwiye kugirira ubuntu abantu batemera.
Ndi Uzair, witwa muri Surah Az-Zukhruf nk'umuntu Imana yumvise ikirego cye.

trial.label: Igeragezwa/Ikibazo

trial.answer: Kwinubira Allah ku byerekeye gukandamizwa kw'abantu

location.answer: Ikirego cyatanzwe ku buryo butaziguye kuri Allah

outcome.answer: Allah yumvise ikirego maze yemeza ko Imana ari Umwe n'Imana Isumba byose

arabic: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن نَّبِىٍّ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verse: But there would not come to them a prophet except that they used to ridicule him. (43:7)
